auto_assignment.claim_branch_rule: Create the exact claim_branch from exact current main without force; an existing branch means claimed. If branch creation is rejected, skip the slot and reconcile rather than invent another branch.
auto_assignment.no_valid_slot_behavior: Make no repository changes and report NO_VALID_WORK_SLOT.

cycle_closeout: Reconcile README current status after meaningful completed work.

Do not present planning, bounded runtime or green regression workflows as full product parity.

SUPERVISOR.description: Exactly one user-designated Supervisor/Integrator coordinates issue/PR preflight, shared truth, claim creation, merge review and closeout.
must_not: Pre-create future worker branches before the queue authorizes them.
Force or reuse a claimed branch.
Allow workers to edit shared project-state truth.

WORKER.description: Workers reconcile issues/PRs first, then claim one eligible non-overlapping slot through the exact deterministic branch declared here.
must_not: Edit README, CHECKPOINT, config/coordination/agent-work-queue.json or another slot's files.
Invent another branch when a deterministic claim exists.
Start runtime work from a planning-only slot.
Execute destructive provider/database/user/content mutation, Backup/Reset side effects, deployment or release.
